components.name: ScheduleResourceGrid
components.description:
Figma `Schedule/Resource-Grid` (16135:145822): a resource timeline. A Border box (`Color/Background/Surface/Default`, 1px
`Color/Border/Neutral/Pale/Default`, Corner-Radius/Base, clipped): a 40px header (the resource column's label and the
scale, Caption/Medium Neutral/Light; today in Accent on the Days scale) over rows of `.Primitives/Schedule/Resource`
beside their track (56 desktop, 64 mobile at Compact; a row grows with a larger density), split by Pale rules. Bookings
are `.Primitives/Calendar/Event-Block` bars: x = start on the scale × column + 2, width = length × column − 4, 4px from
the row's top and bottom; a bar that runs past the range scrolls with the track and is never squeezed to its edge; under
80px it hides its time. A vertical `.Primitives/Calendar/Now-Line` crosses the tracks at now.

Semantics: a `role="table"` — the header row's column headers, then per resource a row header and one cell with the
bars (buttons with `onBookingClick`, named by title and time). On a phone the resource column stays while the scale
scrolls.

props.name: resources
props.description: The rows: people and rooms, in order.

props.name: bookings
props.description: The bookings, shifts and leave on them (by `resourceId`).

props.name: scale
props.description: Figma Scale: `hours` (one day, a column per hour) or `days` (one week, Monday first). Default hours.

props.name: date
props.description: The day shown (Hours) or any day of the week shown (Days). Default: today.

props.name: startHour
props.description: First hour of the Hours scale (default 9).

props.name: endHour
props.description: Hour the Hours scale ends at (default 17: eight working hours).

props.name: now
props.description: The current time: the vertical now line while it is inside the range. Default: the device clock.

props.name: today
props.description: The day treated as today (the Days scale writes it in Accent). Default: `now`'s day.

props.name: resourcesLabel
props.description: The header of the resource column (default the locale's "Team & rooms"; "Team" on a phone).

props.name: onBookingClick
props.description: Pressing a bar: open the booking, anchored to `target`. Without it the bars are static.

props.name: selectedBookingId
props.description: The booking whose details are open: its bar shows State=Selected.

props.name: device
props.description:
Figma Device: `desktop` (200px resource column, the whole scale visible) or `mobile` (64px column, four hours or
three days visible: the track scrolls sideways and opens at the current hour or today). Default: from the
breakpoint.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the grid (default: "Team & rooms" and the period).

props.name: overrides
props.description:
Figma instance overrides of the rows' Resource and the bars (`{ "Row[alex]/Resource": { device: "mobile" } }`).
Written by Zen Studio.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<div>`.

components.name: ScheduleItinerary
components.description:
Figma `Schedule/Itinerary` (16135:13820): a day's programme — a Body/Small/Bold kicker (Neutral/Light) over
`.Primitives/Schedule/Itinerary-Item` stops, Gap/XSmall; stops that ended are Past (Accent rail) up to the one happening
Now; the last stop has no connector. An ordered list: the running stop carries `aria-current="step"`.
Not a calendar of unrelated events (CalendarAgenda) or a history of actions.

props.name: stops
props.description: The stops, in order.

props.name: title
props.description: Figma Kicker: the day and the plan's name ("Wed, Sep 30 · Design Day").

props.name: now
props.description: The current time: stops that ended are Past, the running one Now, the rest Upcoming. Default: the device clock.

props.name: device
props.description: Figma Device: `desktop` (640) or `mobile` (358); the stops are the same. Default: from the breakpoint.

props.name: overrides
props.description: Figma instance overrides of the stops (`{ "Stop[keynote]": { connector: false } }`). Written by Zen Studio.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<div>`.

components.name: ScheduleSlotPicker
components.description:
Figma `Schedule/Slot-Picker` (16135:14046): a booking picker, one `.Primitives/Schedule/Slot` chosen at a time (a radio
group). Desktop: day columns Gap/Small apart, each a header (weekday Caption/Medium Neutral/Light — "Today" in
Accent/Base — over the date in Body/Base/Medium) and its slots Gap/XSmall, filling the column. Mobile: a Calendar/
Week-Strip (Dot) Gap/Medium over Morning / Afternoon / Evening groups — a Body/Small/Bold Light kicker, Gap/XSmall, then
slots three per row Gap/Small apart. Booked or past times are Disabled, struck through, still in place. Each radio is
named with its day and time; the arrow keys move between them.

props.name: slots
props.description: The bookable times (any days); a day shows its slots in time order.

props.name: days
props.description: The days to offer (desktop columns, the phone's week strip). Default: the days the slots fall on, at most five.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen slot's id (controlled).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The chosen slot at first (uncontrolled).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the slot the person picks. The confirm action ("Book 10:00") belongs to the page or sheet footer.

props.name: day
props.description: Phone: the day the slots show (controlled). Default: the chosen slot's day, else the first day.

props.name: onDayChange
props.description: Phone: called with the day picked on the week strip.

props.name: today
props.description: The day treated as today ("Today" in Accent). Default: the device clock.

props.name: device
props.description:
Figma Device: `desktop` (day columns) or `mobile` (a week strip, then Morning / Afternoon groups of three per row,
44px touch targets). Default: from the breakpoint.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the times (default the locale's "Available times").

props.name: name
props.description: The radios' group name (default a generated one).

props.name: overrides
props.description: Figma instance overrides of the slots (`{ "Slot[2026-10-01T10:00]": { size: "sm" } }`). Written by Zen Studio.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<div>`.

components.name: ScheduleDayPlanner
components.description:
Figma `Schedule/Day-Planner` (16143:1439): a person's day — the month as a Heading/3 title with a selector
(Button/Icon-Main Small Tertiary, Gap/XSmall), a Calendar/Week-Strip Style=Tile, a Divider, then an hour rail of
`.Primitives/Schedule/Hour-Label` (the current hour Now) beside `.Primitives/Schedule/Event-Card` cards at their start
time, Gap/Medium between the parts and Gap/Small between rail and cards. A card's top is (start − first hour) × the hour
height and its height the longer of length × hour height − 8 and its content; the hour height (64) grows so cards
never overlap. Cards and the selected day are Border boxes, so the planner reads on any canvas.

props.name: events
props.description: The cards (any days); the planner shows the selected day's.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected day (controlled).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The selected day at first (uncontrolled). Default: today.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the day picked on the week strip.

props.name: title
props.description: Figma Title: the month ("September 2026"). Default: the selected day's month.

props.name: titleLevel
props.description: Heading level of the title (default 2).

props.name: onMonthClick
props.description:
The month selector beside the title (Button/Icon-Main Small Tertiary): open your month picker. Without it the
button is left out.

props.name: onCardMenu
props.description: A card's ⋮: open its actions, anchored to `target`. Without it the cards have no menu.

props.name: startHour
props.description: First hour on the rail (default 9).

props.name: endHour
props.description: Last hour on the rail (default 18).

props.name: now
props.description: The current time: the current hour's label is Now (on today). Default: the device clock.

props.name: today
props.description: The day treated as today. Default: `now`'s day.

props.name: device
props.description: Figma Device: `desktop` (420, a side panel) or `mobile` (a phone screen). Default: from the breakpoint.

props.name: overrides
props.description:
Figma instance overrides of the cards, week strip and month button (`{ "Card[explore]": { color: "teal" } }`).
Written by Zen Studio.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<div>`.

components.name: ScheduleResource
components.description:
Figma `.Primitives/Schedule/Resource` (16133:1070): the row header of Schedule/Resource-Grid. Desktop: Padding XSmall ·
Small, Gap/XSmall, an Avatar/Single Small (Circle, Subtle) or Dock-Icon Small (Neutral Subtle) beside Name
(Body/Small/Medium, Strongest) over Meta (Caption/Regular, Light). Mobile: Padding/2XSmall, Gap/2XSmall, the avatar over
the name in Caption/Medium, centred.

props.name: name
props.description: Figma Name ("Alex Duong"; on mobile a short name, "Alex"). One line, truncated.

props.name: meta
props.description: Figma Meta: a role or a capacity ("Designer", "8 seats"). Desktop only.

props.name: type
props.description:
Figma Type: `person` (an Avatar Small with initials or a photo) or `room` (a Dock-Icon Small, Neutral Subtle,
building icon: any resource — a room, a vehicle, a device).

props.name: avatarSrc
props.description: Person: the photo. Without it the Avatar shows the name's initials.

props.name: avatarTheme
props.description: Person: the initials' theme (Figma exposes it on the Avatar). Default `violet`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Room: the icon (default `icon-building-02-line`).

props.name: device
props.description: Figma Device: `desktop` (200 wide: name and meta) or `mobile` (64 wide: the avatar over a short name).

props.name: overrides
props.description: Figma instance overrides of the Avatar / Dock-Icon it draws (`{ "Avatar": { theme: "teal" } }`). Written by Zen Studio.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<div>`.

components.name: ScheduleSlot
components.description:
Figma `.Primitives/Schedule/Slot` (16133:1087): one bookable time, a radio of the picker's single-choice group, in the
Date-Picker day's colours: `--zen-date-picker-item-background-unselected-*` with a 1px Border/Neutral/Subtle (Hover:
Subtle/Hover), Selected `--zen-date-picker-item-background-seclected-default` with its Selected content, Disabled a
Border/Disabled outline and Content/Disabled struck through. Corner-Radius/Action/Small, Padding 0 · Small, Medium 32
(Body/Small/Medium) or Small 24 (Caption/Medium). A native radio inside a label: the arrow keys move within its group.

props.name: time
props.description: Figma Time ("10:30").

props.name: size
props.description: Figma Size: `md` (Select-Item Medium height; phones and the main picker, default) or `sm`.

props.name: checked
props.description: Figma State=Selected: the chosen time (`checked` of its radio).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Figma State=Disabled: taken or past — struck through, never hidden, so the day keeps its rhythm.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the radio `<input>`.

components.name: ScheduleItineraryItem
components.description:
Figma `.Primitives/Schedule/Itinerary-Item` (16133:1131): one stop of a timed plan. Gap/Small between a 56px time column
(Start Body/Small/Bold over Duration Caption/Regular Light, Gap/3XSmall), a 16px rail (the marker, then a 2px connector,
Padding-top 2XSmall, Gap/2XSmall) and the content (Title Body/Base/Medium, Meta Caption/Regular, Gap/2XSmall,
Padding-bottom Large). Past: Accent/Solid dot and connector, Start / Title / Meta quiet (Light, Base, Light). Now: a
16px Surface ring with a 2px Accent/Solid stroke and a 6px Accent dot, a Badge Small Accent Subtle "Now". Upcoming: a 12px
Surface dot with a 2px Border/Neutral/Solid stroke. Connectors after Now are Border/Neutral/Subtle.

props.name: start
props.description: Figma Start ("13:00").

props.name: duration
props.description: Figma Duration ("90 min").

props.name: title
props.description: Figma Title.

props.name: meta
props.description: Figma Meta: place · who ("Room 2 · Linh Tran").

props.name: status
props.description:
Figma Status: `past` (Accent dot and rail, quiet text), `now` (Accent ring and a Now badge) or `upcoming` (a hollow
neutral dot).

props.name: connector
props.description: Figma Connector: the rail down to the next stop (off on the last one). Default true.

props.name: overrides
props.description: Figma instance overrides of the Now badge (`{ "Badge": { theme: "positive" } }`). Written by Zen Studio.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<div>`.

components.name: ScheduleHourLabel
components.description:
Figma `.Primitives/Schedule/Hour-Label` (16143:488): an hour on the day planner's rail — Padding 3XSmall · XSmall,
Corner-Radius/Rounded, Caption/Medium Neutral/Light; Now on `Color/Background/Accent/Flat/Default`.

props.name: hour
props.description: Figma Hour ("13:00").

props.name: now
props.description: Figma State=Now: the current hour — an Accent Flat pill, Caption/Bold Accent/Strongest.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<span>`.

components.name: ScheduleEventCard
components.description:
Figma `.Primitives/Schedule/Event-Card` (16143:817): an event as a card on the day planner — a Border box
(`Color/Background/Surface/Default`, 1px `Color/Border/Neutral/Pale/Default`, Corner-Radius/2XLarge, Padding/Medium, so
it reads on Canvas/Default and Canvas/Alt), a 4px rule in `Color/Background/Support/<Hue>/Solid`, then Gap/XSmall: Title
(Body/Base/Medium, 2 lines) over Status (Body/Small/Regular, Light) beside the ⋮, the attendees and the time (clock icon,
Caption/Medium Neutral/Light), and an optional note (Surface/Alt, Padding/Small, Corner-Radius/Small = 24 − 16).

props.name: title
props.description: Figma Title (two lines, truncated).

props.name: status
props.description: Figma Status, in words ("Done", "In progress", "Upcoming"): Light; colour stays on the rule.

props.name: time
props.description: Figma Time ("13:00 – 16:00"), after the clock icon.

props.name: color
props.description: Figma Color: the rule's hue (default brand; `neutral` for personal blocks).

props.name: attendees
props.description: Figma Attendees: AvatarStack items (Small, Subtle, up to 3).

props.name: note
props.description: Figma Note + Note-Text: a Surface/Alt box under the meta.

props.name: onMenuClick
props.description:
Figma Menu: the ⋮ (Button/Icon-Flat Small Secondary in a 20px wrapper, the Card Sub-Action). Its name is the
locale's "Actions for {title}" unless `menuLabel` says otherwise. Without it the menu is left out.

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: The ⋮ button's accessible name.

props.name: overrides
props.description:
Figma instance overrides of the menu button and avatars (`{ "Menu": { icon: "icon-dots-horizontal-line" } }`).
Written by Zen Studio.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<article>`.
